accelerator_host_interconnect: NVLink-C2C (NVIDIA Vera CPU to NVIDIA Rubin GPU)
accelerator_interconnect_topology: NVL72 NVLink scale-up fabric. DeepSeek-R1 allocates 18 four-GPU nodes in one NVLink domain (--segment=18). Qwen3-VL allocates 18 four-GPU nodes with --segment=1; its allocation need not occupy one NVLink domain.
cooling: Mix of Liquid-cooled (for CPU, GPU, ConnectX-9, NVLink Switches) and Air-cooled (for the rest of the components)
framework: DeepSeek-R1: TensorRT-LLM feat/dsr1_26.08, NVIDIA Dynamo 1.5.1; Qwen3-VL: vLLM CentML/q3vl-release-parity @5bdd885b602e, NVIDIA Dynamo 1.6.0.dev20261019
host_network_card_count: for each 4-GPU node: 4x Mellanox BlueField-4 [ConnectX-9 Lx], 1x Intel I210 Gigabit Ethernet
host_networking_topology: Endpoint client and Dynamo frontend(s) are colocated on a SUT CPU host, with client-to-frontend HTTP over the local host/loopback. Frontends dispatch requests to workers on the allocated hosts. The recipes configure a TCP request plane and NVLink/InfiniBand GPU communication; disaggregated KV-cache transfers use NIXL/UCX.
host_storage_capacity: for each 4-GPU node: 2 TB SSD, 5 TB CIFS
host_storage_type: NVMe SSD, CIFS mounted disk storage
hw_notes: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, 2300W TGP Per GPU. SUT: 18 nodes x 4 GPUs (72 GPUs). DeepSeek-R1: four prefill workers x 2 GPUs; Offline/Server use eight decode workers x 8 GPUs, Interactive uses four decode workers x 16 GPUs; eight Dynamo frontends and the endpoint client share CLIENT_NODE_INDEX. Qwen3-VL Offline/Server: 72 TP1 workers. Qwen3-VL Interactive: 48 TP1 prefill workers and 24 TP1 decode workers; the Dynamo frontend, endpoint client, etcd and NATS run on node 0.
other_hardware: Public hardware specification and availability reference: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/vera-rubin-nvl72/ . Topology/placement is specified by the submitted configs/deepseek_r1/VR-NVL72_VR-288GB_aarch64x72 and configs/qwen3_vl_235b_a22b/VR-NVL72_VR-288GB_aarch64x72 recipes.
other_software_stack: CUDA 13.4.1, Driver 620.62; DeepSeek-R1: TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo 1.5.1; Qwen3-VL: vLLM, NVIDIA Dynamo 1.6.0.dev20261019
sw_notes: DeepSeek-R1: CUDA 13.4.1, TensorRT 11.2.1.2, cuDNN 9.25, NCCL 2.30.7, PyTorch 2.14.0a0 (NGC nvcr.io/nvidia/tensorrt-llm/devel:1.3.0rc27), Driver 620.62, TensorRT-LLM feat/dsr1_26.08 @521c43be4e5f, nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.0, FlashInfer 0.6.18.post1, UCX 1.22.0, NIXL 1.3, NVIDIA Dynamo 1.5.1 (ai-dynamo, ai-dynamo-runtime), MLPerf Endpoints client (mlcommons/endpoints @598dbfde); Qwen3-VL: CUDA 13.4.1, PyTorch 2.16.0.dev20261009+cu134, vLLM CentML/q3vl-release-parity @5bdd885b602efa7a4898f9a5f541dfcb9b04b0fa, FlashInfer 0.7.2+rubin.fmha.20261028.g73a15cbe (CentML/q3vl-release-parity @73a15cbe2e9e882f1d8258fccc0550acdc537a3f), NCCL 2.32.3, nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.0, NIXL 1.5.0, UCX @425fb1bcf0f26a92364247a359130090fdc1ecd0, NVIDIA Dynamo 1.6.0.dev20261019, NVFP4 weights with BF16 unquantized tensors, FP8 KV cache; see src/nv_mlpinf/benchmarks/q3vl/rubin/README.md for the image build pins
